items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Basie said “sometime I hope you can play with the band” or something like that. He was very kind.

ctx.x: Do you remember anything about that, like meeting Basie or getting Basie’s reaction to the music or anything?
Basie said “sometime I hope you can play with the band” or something like that. He was very kind.
